name: The Four Tenets of AI
author: Joshua Almeida
rule: Each tenet has to be as low as possible.

tenets.name: Cost
tenets.measure: USD, tokens, or compute-seconds per answer

tenets.name: Bridge
tenets.definition: Glue/integration hops connecting AI to the real world (APIs, tools, translation layers).
tenets.measure: integration hops / tool calls per task

tenets.name: Work
tenets.definition: Steps, retries, and loops to reach a result.
tenets.measure: steps and retries per task within a fixed budget

tenets.name: Theory
tenets.definition: Unproven assumptions and unverified claims the system relies on.
